name.pt-BR: Exercícios espirituais e celestiais de Granada (Meres, inglês, 1598)

description.en-US: Francis Meres's 1598 English version of Louis of Granada's seven short meditations for the days of the week (prologue, then Monday to Sunday), with the volume's exposition of Psalm 51 and a prayer on the name of Jesus. It follows the Latin and French redactions, not a single chapter of the Spanish Manual, so it is its own book.
description.pt-BR: A versão inglesa de Francis Meres (1598) das sete meditações para os dias da semana de Luís de Granada, com uma exposição do Salmo 51.

sources.edition: Granados Spirituall and Heavenlie Exercises, divided into seven pithie and briefe meditations, for every day in the weeke one, englished by Francis Meres (1598), EEBO-TCP A06448, with the Exposition of the 51st Psalm and a Prayer of the name of Jesus bound with it.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription (A06448), old spelling kept; long s printed as s, vv as w. 9 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Marginal notes are footnotes. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Printed 1598; the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
